Wispae
Scientific Name: Wishpower-Enriched Micro-Willpower Crystalline Faekind
Faekind Class, Wispae Family, Wispae Genus

What Are We?
Wispae are the smallest unit of Wishpower. You can also think of them as "the smallest wishes."

In Planarcadia, the gathering and disintegration of wispae shapes the life of imagenae.

The Life Sciences Institute in turn, strives to push each individual wispae to the peak of their potential.

"In helping every wispae find its own worth, even the smallest wishes come true."

Where Do We Come From?
Due to their simple thought processes, low Wishpower consumption, and limited acuity for negative emotions such as fear and fatigue, wispae are the best-suited species for assembly-line work in this world. Their Wishpower structure (which is identical to that of imagenae), combined with their emotional stability, also makes them ideal experimental materials for related research.

Using these as benchmarks, the Life Sciences Institute has conducted long-term selective breeding of wispae across multiple criteria including jumping ability, stress tolerance, and tameness. The result is specimens that have made significant contributions to improving the IPC's production efficiency.

Note: All wispae displayed across the park are bred inside the park.

What Do We Do?
Wispae have short lifespans and love stacking on top of each other to unwind. By squishing and squeezing between the upper and lower layers, wispae can exchange Wishpower and help each other work through negative emotions.

It's also most people's favorite wispae interaction to watch.

Don'ts!
Researchers have observed that when massive numbers of wispae congregate, they may spontaneously begin mimicking human social structures. Therefore, outside controlled experimental observation, Life Sciences Institute personnel are strictly prohibited from facilitating situations involving "large, unmanaged gatherings of wispae."

Please be respectful during your visit. Maintain a safe distance from the wispae, and refrain from tapping the glass or shouting. Thank you for your cooperation.
